title: Request letter for Vi
about: A short letter to take to a Vi store with Vi's own Transfer of Ownership Request form and the papers Vi lists. Vi asks for its form; this letter is not a requirement.
takeWith: Vi's own Transfer of Ownership Request form

sources.confirms: Vi FAQ: for a deceased customer, visit a Vi store with the request form, death certificate, relationship proof or legal heir certificate, and POI/POA.

letter.text: Subject: Transfer of ownership of the mobile number of {{deceasedName}}
I am writing to inform you that {{deceasedName}}, the customer for the mobile number below, has passed away.
Please transfer the ownership of this mobile number to me. I have enclosed the papers listed below.

letter.title: Enclosed:
items: Vi's Transfer of Ownership Request form, filled in
A copy of the death certificate
Proof of relationship, or a legal heir certificate
My proof of identity and proof of address
